noun_definition: Word refers to the text displayed on the 'Choose File' button in the scan request money feature of the app, which should have only the first letter of the first word capitalized according to the app's formatting standards.

Choose file button refers to the UI element in the app that allows users to select a file, which is currently displayed with both words capitalized instead of following the app's standard capitalization style.
Scan request money refers to the action of initiating a money request in the app by selecting the 'Scan' option, which is part of the user interface for requesting funds.
